AccessTokenAlgorithm.description:
The signature algorithms an offer token may be signed with.

The same closed vocabulary Evidence accepts on its own resource-server
profile. Mixing families is refused when the configuration loads rather than
when the first token arrives.

ClaimNamesDocument.description:
The contextual claim names an offer-token issuer uses. Each is distinct,
and none is a registered or authentication claim.

EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

EvidenceDocument.description: The Evidence deployment this service requests credentials from.

baseUrl.description: The Evidence base URL, with no query or fragment. https in strict mode.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. Each file must be a
regular file owned by the runtime user, mode 0400 or 0600, with exactly
one hard link.

IdentifierRestriction.description:
Which values a gate admits: the keyword `unrestricted`, or a nonempty list
of the admitted values. An empty list is refused, because it reads as both
"nothing" and "anything".

ListenerBind.description: Socket address the runtime listens on, written host:port with an IP address host ([addr]:port for IPv6).

ListenerConfig.description: The listener of a runtime that declares no TLS or exposure settings.

ListenerDocument.description: The listener a wallet and an adopter reach.

maximumRequestBytes.description:
The largest request body accepted, in bytes. A limit no wallet request
can survive leaves the service reporting itself ready while every
request fails.

requestTimeoutMilliseconds.description: How long one request may take, in milliseconds.

OffersDocument.description: The authorization boundary of the adopter-facing offer endpoint.

algorithms.description: The one signature algorithm an offer token may be signed with.

audiences.description:
The audiences this service answers to, each at most 256 bytes. A token
issued for anything else is refused.

authorizedClients.description:
Client identifiers permitted to create offers, each at most 128 bytes,
or `unrestricted` for any client the issuer vouched for.

claims.description:
Contextual claim names used by this offer-token issuer. Keep these
aligned with Evidence when both verify tokens from the same deployment.

issuer.description:
The authorization server that issues offer tokens, compared exactly
against a token's `iss`. https in strict mode.

jwksUri.description: The offer-token issuer's key set. https in strict mode.

maximumTokenLifetimeSeconds.description: The longest lifetime an offer token may carry, in seconds.

requiredScopes.description:
Scopes every offer token must carry, each an RFC 6749 scope token of at
most 256 bytes, or `unrestricted` for no scope gate. Generated
configurations state `oid4vci:offer`.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

StoreDocument.description: The bounds of the in-memory store.

accessTokenLifetimeSeconds.description: How long an access token lives, in seconds.

maximumOffers.description:
How many offers the store holds. A store too small to hold a
deployment's live offers refuses new ones rather than forgetting old
ones.

maximumTransactionCodeAttempts.description: How many wrong transaction codes an offer survives.

nonceLifetimeSeconds.description: How long a nonce lives, in seconds; at most the access token lifetime.

offerLifetimeSeconds.description:
How long an offer lives, in seconds. Minutes, in both directions:
shorter than a person can scan a code and read a message, and the flow
cannot complete; longer, and a stolen offer stays useful.

TokenClientDocument.description: The identity this service authenticates to its token issuer with.

clientAssertionAudience.description:
The value the endpoint expects as the client assertion `aud`. Absent
means the token endpoint, which is the usual registration.

clientId.description:
The client identifier registered with the token issuer, at most 128
bytes.

privateKeyRef.description:
The client's own private JWK, as `secret:file/<name>` under
`secretProviders.file.root` or `secret:env/<NAME>`. Resolved when the
outbound client is built, never logged and never rendered.

resource.description:
The fixed RFC 8707 resource identifier of the Evidence API: an
absolute URI with no fragment or user information.

scopes.description:
The exact scopes requested from the issuer for Evidence access: 1 to
32 distinct RFC 6749 scope tokens. Absent requests no scope.

tokenEndpoint.description: The token endpoint, with no query or fragment. https in strict mode.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host, no user information, and no whitespace or control character.

ValidationMode.description:
The transport validation boundary selected for this process.

A two-axis transport vocabulary with deliberately no third assurance
concept: a delivery front end that graded itself on its own scale would
invent a security property nothing else in the stack recognizes.

oneOf.description: Every published and called origin uses https.

One supervised process group on loopback: the credential issuer is a
canonical `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` origin the listener binds exactly,
and every called origin is https or a 127.0.0.1 HTTP origin.

description:
The wallet-delivery runtime file: one deployment of the OID4VCI delivery
front end for Evidence credentials.

apiVersion.description: The format version of this file.

credentialIssuer.description:
The `credential_issuer` identifier this service publishes, and the
value a wallet proof must carry as its `aud`: a bare origin with no
path, query, or fragment. https in strict mode. A trailing slash is
removed, so what is published and what is compared are the same bytes.

evidence.description: The Evidence deployment this service requests credentials from.

listener.description: The listener a wallet and an adopter reach.

metricsListener.description:
The optional operator-only metrics listener: a loopback or private
address the delivery listener does not use. Absent means no metrics
endpoint exists.

offers.description: The authorization boundary of the adopter-facing offer endpoint.

store.description: The bounds of the in-memory store.

tokenClient.description: The identity this service authenticates to its token issuer with.

validationMode.description: The transport validation boundary. Absent means strict.
